checks.noAgent: No agent "{{id}}" in this project. Create it first.

check.title: Conformance check
check.hint: Runs the agent on one task against a scripted model through the fault proxy. Free: no model key is used. Any FAIL row means the agent will not run reliably in experiments.
check.needSuite: Name a suite to check against, for example {{suite}}.

build.title: Build image
build.hintPerSuite: This agent builds one image per suite (build.base_arg): name the suite.
build.hintPrebuilt: This agent has no build.dockerfile: it uses a prebuilt image.
build.hosted: Hosted servers do not build images. Push your image to a registry, pin it with @sha256: in the agent config, and use Run check above.
build.nothing: Nothing to build. Add a build section in the Config tab to build here.
build.needSuite: Name the suite this image is built for.

diff.title: Compare versions
diff.hint: What changed between this agent's two newest config versions and which tasks flipped, over sealed runs.

tools.noAgent: Open an agent from the Agents page to edit its tools.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: A skill is a folder holding SKILL.md. Uploads land in {{dir}}/ and the agent config's skills.extra lists that folder. Scan a skill before you trust it: the admission scan looks for exfiltration, hidden instructions and risky install steps.
skills.confirmDelete: Delete skill {{name}}? Its files are removed from the project.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Upload a zipped skill folder below.
skills.notInstalled: The config does not list {{dir}} in skills.extra, so runs do not install these skills yet. Upload again or add it in the Config tab.
skills.name: Skill name
skills.uploaded: Skill {{name}} uploaded. Every run of this agent now installs it.
skills.needZip: Choose a .zip of the skill folder (it must hold SKILL.md).
skills.tooLarge: The zip is larger than {{mb}} MiB.
skills.badName: Name the skill: letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.

mcp.title: MCP tools
mcp.hint: How the agent is told about MCP servers (the config format and where it is written in the container), and the MCP servers this agent is meant to use. Tasks still declare the servers a run starts; list them here to scan them before use.
